summary: Frontend-only live test of Nameword landing page focused on Phase 2 (Testimonials + FAQ accordion) plus regression across all landing sections. Landing renders with NO Vite error overlay and NO white screen after the GuaranteesStrip.jsx fix. All required data-testids are present on first paint (announcement-bar, hero-heading/reassure/tld chips, trust-item-0..3, glance-*, testimonial-0..2, rewards-band + perk-0..3 + rewards-cta, guarantees-strip + guarantee-0..3, faq-list + faq-item-0..5 + faq-trigger-0..5 + faq-answer-0, final-cta, cta-create-account, cta-browse-domains). Announcement bar dismisses (element removed). FAQ accordion: item-0 open by default; clicking faq-trigger-2 opens answer-2 and closes answer-0 (single-open behavior); clicking trigger-2 again collapses it (chevron rotation via rotate-180 class). Hero live domain search submits to real reseller API and hero-search-results appears. glance-dns click routed to /sign-in as expected while logged out. Dark mode toggle flips html.className to 'dark'; testimonial figure bg = rgb(9,8,13) and FAQ item bg = rgb(9,8,13) — proper dark surfaces, white/quote text legible, no light-on-light. 390px mobile: document.scrollWidth == clientWidth (390 == 390), NO horizontal scroll, testimonials and FAQ stack cleanly. i18n: setting localStorage language='es' and reloading rendered fully Spanish Testimonials ("Trasladé mi publicación offshore...", role "Editor independiente") and Spanish FAQ triggers ("¿Qué significa realmente «sin DMCA»?") — no raw i18n keys leaked. Static verification of site.fr.js confirms full French translations for testimonials/faq blocks. Live server plan cards (Cloud VPS $18–$288, Windows RDP $56–$224) render with prices from the live reseller API. No React/JSX errors captured. Numerous 429 responses were observed on rapid reloads (Vite HMR dev server rate-limiting the preview host) — this is a preview-environment side effect, not a landing bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Faq.jsx AnimatePresence works correctly, but the accordion allows all items to be closed (open === -1). Product-wise fine, but the review request states 'first item is open by default' which is honored via useState(0).

Rapid reloads against the Vite dev preview trigger 429 rate limits that can produce transient blank pages during test runs — consider using a served/prod build for automated regression to avoid flakiness (not a code bug).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 2 (Testimonials + FAQ) tests pass in EN/ES with dark mode + 390px mobile. FR runtime render was skipped after ES verification because the Vite dev host rate-limited repeated reloads (429s produced a transient blank load); static FR locale content is present and translated. If retesting FR at runtime, add larger delays between reloads or hit a production build. GuaranteesStrip.jsx line 33 fix is confirmed live — no crash.
